# rail_sites

Rail sites records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="rail_sites", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="rail_sites", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active_binding` | null, string | Top-level filter | Active binding: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `category` | string | Top-level filter | Category: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `currency` | string | Top-level filter | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `entity_id` | string | Top-level filter | Entity id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `market` | string | Top-level filter | Market: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `ready_due_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Ready due minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `sender_configuration` | string | Top-level filter | Sender configuration: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `sender_rail` | string | Top-level filter | Sender rail: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `sender_review_minute` | integer, null | Top-level filter | Sender review minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `COLLECTING`, `NOT_CONNECTED`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `test_delay` | integer | Top-level filter | Test delay: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `validation_delay` | integer | Top-level filter | Validation delay: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
